# VISTAR — Founder-Led Web Engineering & Custom Software Studio
> VISTAR is a founder-led engineering studio based in Lucknow, India, led by Abhishek Tiwari (Founder & Lead Engineer). VISTAR designs and engineers high-performance web applications, custom software platforms, WhatsApp business automation, and interactive 3D WebGL experiences with 100% private repository handover in 14-day production sprints.
> Full technical specification & portfolio: https://www.vistar.tech/llms-full.txt

## What We Build

### 1. Modern Web & Application Engineering
- High-performance web applications built with Next.js 15/16 (App Router), React 19, and TypeScript.
- PostgreSQL relational databases, typed schemas, and edge runtime optimizations.
- Sub-100ms response targets with Core Web Vitals optimization.
- 100% source code ownership delivered to your private GitHub repository on day one.
- Reference: https://www.vistar.tech/vectors

### 2. WhatsApp Business & Workflow Automation
- Conversational business workflows and CRM integrations via WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
- Lead capture, automated follow-ups, appointment booking, and customer inquiry routing.
- Direct operational integration with PostgreSQL, webhooks, and modern backend systems.
- Reference: https://www.vistar.tech/vectors

### 3. Spatial WebGL & Interactive 3D Systems
- 60fps Three.js, React Three Fiber, and WebGL GPU-accelerated interactive browser experiences.
- Custom GLSL shaders and procedural spatial graphics for architecture, product showcases, and brands.
- Reference: https://www.vistar.tech/vectors

## Active Portfolio & Open Source Work

- **3axis Arc (Spatial 3D Architecture Platform)**: Interactive 60fps WebGL architectural visualization platform built in React 19. https://3axisarc.vercel.app
- **Project VAYU (Aviation Cockpit Telemetry & NOTAM AI)**: Open-source situational awareness and GIS flight hazard exploration prototype. https://ai-vayu.vercel.app
- **AURA (Healthcare Biometric Anomaly Detection Prototype)**: Synthetic patient telemetry streaming with unsupervised Isolation Forest ML. https://multi-agent-anomaly-system.onrender.com

## Engineering Commitments
- **100% Codebase Ownership**: Private GitHub repository transfer on day one.
- **Zero Vendor Lock-In**: No proprietary black boxes or hostage retainer fees.
- **14-Day Production Sprints**: Scoped, fixed-timeline milestones with direct engineer communication.
- **Modern Infrastructure**: Hosted on edge-native platforms (Vercel, AWS, GCP, Cloudflare) chosen to fit your scale and budget.
